results.title: Troye Sivan Taps Nicole Kidman for ‘She’s the Best’ Music Video
results.description: Troye Sivan has kicked off a new era with the release of his new single “She’s the Best” along with a music video co-starring Nicole Kidman. In the clip, directed by Gordon Von Steiner, Sivan holds the spotlight at a club filled with drag queens, including Sasha Colby.
